extDesc.message: 2FA codes in nested folders with an archive. Encrypted sync with your Android phone through your own Google Drive.

migration_fail.message: Importimi dështoi. Nëse je duke migruar të dhënat nga Google Authenticator, ju lutem ri-eksporto të dhënat e tua nga Google Authenticator dhe provoni përsëri.

migration_partly_fail.message: Disa të dhëna të llogarisë nuk janë importuar në mënyrë të sukseshme.

confirm_delete.message: A jeni i sigurtë qe doni të fshini këtë llogari? Ky veprim nuk mund të zhbëhet.

confirm_delete_all.message: E kuptoj se të gjithë të dhënat e mia do të fshihen dhe do të jenë të parikuperueshme.
confirm_delete_all.description: Message that user is required to acknowledge before clearing all data.

delete_all_warning.message: Kjo do të fshijë të gjithë plotësisht të dhënat tuaja dhe kthejë Authenticator në gjendje fillestare. Ju nuk do të jeni në gjendje të riktheni të dhënat e fshira! Ju duhet të konsideroni ruajtjen e një kopje rezervë përpara rikthimit në gjëndje fillestare të Authenticator-it.

security_warning.message: Ky fjalëkalim do të përdoret për të kriptuar llogarinë tënde. Askush nuk mund tju ndihmojë ju nëse ju harroni fjalëkalimin.

phrase_incorrect.message: Ju nuk mund të shtoni një llogari të re derisa të gjitha llogaritë janë të dekriptuara. Ju lutem vendosni fjalkalimin korrekt përpara se të vazhdoni.

phrase_incorrect_export.message: Llogaritë që nuk mundën të dekriptohen nuk do të përfshihen në këtë backup.

sync_title.description: Title of the sync settings page.

sync_intro.message: Upload your accounts to your own Google Drive, or download them from it. The data is encrypted on this device with a sync passphrase before it leaves, and is stored in a hidden app-data folder that only this extension can see.
sync_intro.description: Explanation of how Drive sync works.

sync_warning_unrecoverable.message: Only you know the sync passphrase. If you forget it, the data on Drive cannot be recovered by anyone, including the developer.

sync_no_warranty.message: No warranty: this feature is provided as is. The developer never receives or stores your data. It lives only in your own Google Drive, encrypted with your passphrase. You are responsible for keeping your own backups.

sync_passphrase_new_info.message: There is no sync file on Drive yet. Choose a sync passphrase. It is different from the password that protects this extension.
sync_passphrase_new_info.description: Info about creating a new passphrase.

sync_passphrase_mismatch.message: The two passphrases do not match.

sync_working.message: Working. Deriving the key can take a few seconds.

sync_unlock_first.message: Unlock the extension with your password first. Locked accounts cannot be synced.

sync_conflict_info.message: Nothing has been changed yet. Choose what to do.

sync_this_device.description: Label for this device in conflict dialog.

sync_drive.description: Label for Google Drive in conflict dialog.

sync_choice_add.description: Option to add missing items only.

sync_choice_overwrite.message: Overwrite changed accounts on the side being changed
sync_choice_overwrite.description: Option to also overwrite changed items.

sync_choice_mirror.description: Option to delete items missing on other side.

sync_choice_add_info.message: Adds accounts that the target does not have. Nothing is overwritten or deleted.

sync_choice_overwrite_info.message: Also copies the changed values (name, folder, archive, and so on) over matching accounts on the target. Nothing is deleted.

sync_choice_mirror_info.message: Also deletes accounts on the target that are not on the other side, so the target becomes identical.

sync_target_changes.message: The following side will be changed:
sync_target_changes.description: Label showing which side will be changed.

sync_confirm_mirror.message: This deletes accounts that the other side does not have. Continue?

sync_in_sync.message: Already in sync. Nothing was changed.

sync_nothing_on_drive.message: There is nothing on Drive yet. Upload first.

sync_erase_confirm.message: Delete the sync file from your Drive? Your accounts on this device are not touched.

sync_error_not_configured.message: Sync is not set up in this build (no Google OAuth client ID).
sync_error_not_configured.description: Error when sync is not configured.

sync_error_auth.message: Google sign-in was not completed or was denied.

sync_error_network.message: Could not reach Google Drive. Check your connection.

sync_error_http.description: Error when Drive returns HTTP error.

sync_error_wrong_passphrase.message: Wrong passphrase, or the file on Drive is damaged. Nothing was changed.

sync_error_bad_file.message: The file on Drive is not readable by this version.

sync_error_permission.message: The permission needed to sign in with Google was not granted.
